narrative.details:
Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, adventurer? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.

First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.
narrative.objectives: Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan.
narrative.offerRewardText: These'll do fine, Ukko.Fire ain't just fury and ruin--mark me words. It's life, it's forge, it's the breath o' creation. All things are bound in balance. One force tempers the other, gives it meaning. Without shadow, light's but a glare. Without flame, stone's but cold memory.Masterin' magic means knowin' when to blend, not just burn. That's true wisdom, lad.
narrative.requestItemsText: Aye, I've near all I need for the fire sapta, Ukko--just missin' the fire tar and the seer's pouch. The tar's carried by Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north. The pouch ye'll need to wrest from a Stonesplinter seer in the southern hills. These ingredients are bound to flame, as all true saptas must be. Their elemental ties make our craft strong.
